environment.description: Same Terraform provider API deployed in namespace 'terraform-system' on a GKE cluster with Istio 1.19 service mesh (strict mTLS enforced cluster-wide via PeerAuthentication). An AuthorizationPolicy resource is applied in the 'terraform-system' namespace with spec.action DENY for requests where source.namespace is not in ['terraform-system', 'ci-runners']. Additionally, a second AuthorizationPolicy with ALLOW action requires request.auth.claims[iss] to match 'https://token-issuer.internal.corp.net' — however this policy only validates presence of the claim after Istio's RequestAuthentication has already verified the JWT signature using its own jwksUri pointing to the internal OIDC provider. Note: the application-level JWT validation (the vulnerable code) runs AFTER the Envoy sidecar has already authorized the connection. The Envoy sidecar terminates mTLS and applies authorization before traffic reaches the application container on port 8443.
